set.approach: The ice forms in the Left Hand Fork of Maple Canyon. Park at the pullout at the canyon mouth and hike or ski up the main road, which is snow-covered in winter, passing Box Canyon on the right, until three canyons converge; turn left and head south up the Left Hand Fork, watching for the flows. set.approach: Take the Mount Olympus trail to where it cuts into Tolcat Canyon, then leave it at the seam of the V and follow the trees across the base of the rock band, with some bushwhacking. Pass a small cave or tunnel in the stone and angle upward until you reach a point with a deep gully across from a ridge; the climb is left of and below a tree on the prow. The ice tops out by meandering up a gully, so the line is not obvious from below.

review.notes: Approach from area and route pages (route comment gives the line); medium.
